subject: Recap & Observability plan for FintechX POC - success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechx.com>, Marco Rossi <mrossi@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: POC observability plan & next steps

Hi Asha / Marco —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the POC observability scope so we have alignment before kickoff. Please confirm or call out any changes.

POC timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff: Monday 2026-10-19, 10:00 AM PT
- Duration: 2 weeks (10/19-11/02)
- Check-ins: brief standup at day 3 and weekly review at end of POC

Success criteria (what FintechX will measure)
- End-to-end latency: p95 < 350ms for typical requests
- Error rate: < 0.5% (5xx / total requests)
- Token cost per session: monitor trend and ensure cost per 1k requests within expected budget
- Stable throughput: sustained X qps (we'll validate target in kickoff)
- Observability: dashboards + alerts available and validated by FintechX SREs

Evaluation plan / ownership
- FintechX: Asha (infra lead) owns verification of dashboards, acceptance of metrics, and test traffic generation
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead) for coordination; Jordan (solutions) for dashboard + alert templates; Marcus (SRE) for tracing/log agent support

Observability scope (items we'll deliver)
- Dashboards: latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, request volume, token-cost per request, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, model fallback rate
- Tracing: distributed traces for request path; default sample rate 5% with ability to raise to 20% during anomaly windows
- Logs: structured request logs; export to FintechX ELK (or S3/BigQuery if you prefer)
- Alerts: page/Slack alerts for high error rate, p99 spike, model fallback > threshold

Attachments: observability_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 250 KB) ; POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (Excel, 45 KB)

Next steps
1) Confirm kickoff date/time and log export target (ELK vs BigQuery)
2) Asha: share access details for ELK / log ingest endpoint and provide initial qps target
3) We will share sample dashboard links and a short runbook before kickoff

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Rossi <mrossi@fintechx.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: POC observability plan & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side:

- Timeline: Monday 10/19 kickoff works for us. We expect to run the trial for two weeks as proposed.
- Logs: we'd prefer logs exported to our ELK stack rather than BigQuery for ease of integration with existing dashboards. Will share ELK ingest credentials (or a temporary endpoint) ahead of kickoff.
- Traces: 5% default sampling sounds reasonable. Please include an option to increase sampling to 20% during targeted debugging windows.
- Retention: we need request logs retained for 30 days for the POC. Is that straightforward?
- SLA: can you confirm what uptime/backstop we should expect during the POC window (SLO for us as a customer)? We don't need an enterprise SLA but would like to know how Redwood will handle incidents during the POC.

Also: could you share sample dashboard screenshots (panel layout + suggested alert thresholds) so our SREs can quickly validate?

I'll loop in our infra person (Marco) to coordinate access — he'll be the day-to-day for the integration.

Thanks,
Asha

Asha Mehta
Infrastructure Lead, FintechX
asha@fintechx.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marco Rossi <mrossi@fintechx.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: POC observability plan & next steps

Great — thanks Asha. Confirming updates and next steps below.

Adjustments based on your notes:
- Logs: we'll export to FintechX ELK. Please provide ingest endpoint and a temporary user with write access; we will deliver structured logs in JSON.
- Tracing: default 5% sample, with on-demand increase to 20% for up to 2-hour debugging windows (can trigger via our console).
- Retention: we'll retain POC logs for 30 days (as requested). If you need longer retention we can discuss archive options post-POC.
- POC SLA/backstop: during the POC we provide 99% service availability expectation for inference endpoints; we will treat incidents as priority and provide a dedicated Slack channel for incident coordination. This is not an enterprise SLA but is our operational commitment for the trial.

Deliverables before kickoff (we'll complete these by EOD Fri 10/16 PT):
- Sample dashboards (attached screenshot): latency panels, error rate, token-cost per request, cache hit-rate. Attachment: dashboard_samples.png
- Runbook: short checklist to validate data flow and alert thresholds (link: https://drive.redwood.com/fintechx/poc/observability-plan-v1)
- Shared alert thresholds proposal (included in observability_plan_v1.pdf)

Kickoff meeting: Monday 10/19, 10:00 AM PT — I'll send calendar invite after you confirm ELK access.

Ownership / action items
- Asha (FintechX): provide ELK ingest details and initial target qps / test plans
- Marco (FintechX): coordinate access and validate dashboard panels
- Jordan (Redwood): prep dashboards and alert templates
- Marcus (Redwood): instrument tracing agent and validate log format
- Marissa (Redwood): send M&A and kickoff invite; coordinate on-runbook

Please reply with a quick sign-off and ELK details when ready.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
